correctness.rationale: For arbitrary integral graph Laplacian, an exact two-block recurrence yields top Krylov columns -t K U with U integer upper unitriangular; elementary integer operations give diag(1,tK). The determinant sign and t^n factor follow directly. The sharp n=9 census enumerates every unlabeled tree by complete leaf extension with an isomorphism-invariant centroid encoding and computes each rooted Kalman determinant by exact fraction-free integer elimination. The 9-vertex parity obstruction is proved using det absolute 2 and a verified mod-2 left annihilator; repeated leaf extension supplies witnesses of all larger orders. The checker covers 749 tree-root instances, 326 unit-leaf transfer instances, and explicit weighted block identities; these computations do not replace the universal algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Quantized-input reachability requires the integer image of a Kalman matrix, rather than merely real rank. Preserving full Smith invariants under a natural pendant graph operation is a structural invariant, while the least-order tree admitting an index-two obstruction gives a sharp meaningful boundary and a concrete parity characterization of unreachable targets. Rank-controllability literature alone does not supply this information; an exact minimal finite cutoff and arbitrarily large witnesses address a natural graph-control design question.
